extracted.summary: The ANRF-National Post Doctoral Fellowship (N-PDF) is a prestigious initiative by the Government of India to support young researchers with a Ph.D. in science, engineering, or medicine for a two‑year post‑doctoral fellowship.
extracted.amount_text: INR 80,000 per month plus applicable HRA, or INR 50,000 for pending degree holders. A research grant of INR 2,00,000 per year. An overhead of INR 1,00,000 per year.
extracted.categories_quote: Age must not exceed 35 years at the time of application, with a 5 year relaxation for SC, ST, OBC, physically challenged and female candidates.
extracted.course_levels_quote: Applicants must hold a Ph.D. in Science or Engineering, or an M.D. or M.S. from a recognised university.
